main: All Different annotated rows with distinct source passages. Same secondary only for source-distinct examples. No fitting.
unit: question, paired by question, cluster bootstrap by normalized Wikipedia article across questions. Source Recall at input = 1 by construction. Primary handoff full-pair count scoring both complete source texts.
design: Two transparent deterministic workers. One target and five hard distractors each, shuffled, six opaque slots. To form distractors, exclude own article and exact gold text, interleave global BM25 and zero-shot E5 highest ranked non-target texts until 10 unique; hash-shuffle into two partitions. No gold/IDs/titles given to selector, no original FAQ text in artifacts, answers never used.
protocol: Global binary application-payload cap 1536 bytes; secondary 768 & 3072. Free framing implies separate scheme at demo. Each worker sends variable-length complete passage frames with content address uint64 + uint16 size + UTF8 bytes. Both workers have equal quotas. No partial records. Baseline receives full quota with no synopsis. Pair protocol sends each of 12 candidates' 2-byte cosine and 16-byte random-hyperplane sketch, then receives a 1-byte slot request per worker; total overhead 218 bytes; same fallback pack in local cosine order. Local-only with matching dummy packet and shuffled sketch are ablations. Exact payload bytes retained via SHA and lengths.
proposed: Compute unary scores quantized E5 cosine; percentile on each worker, plus unit-weight midrank percentile of cross-worker agreement on 128 sign bits from mean-centered passage vectors (unsupervised mean of entire unlabeled source corpus); take max over 36 edges. Compare independent E5, network-overhead-matched E5, rewired sketches, BM25. Requested candidate prioritized, then local unary fills space. No fit or tuning.
contrast: At 1536 primary pair vs independent E5 (same total cap). Mechanistic contrasts pair vs matched nulls. Only primary interval formal; all other budgets/contrasts descriptive. Raw paired wins/losses and cluster percentile bootstrap seed 2107, 10000 resamples of article groups.
extra: One-slot-per-worker sensitivity holds fixed evidence count (up to two whole passages), retains same wire accounting; self-contained case study, no Judge Pass claim. Positive or negative results publish alike.
